citations.quote: That's why I support the Street Safety Act the Board adopted in 2025.
citations.locator: Transit Infrastructure section, answer on whether Vision Zero is the right goal

notes: His questionnaire names the Street Safety Act the Board adopted in 2025; the Board's record is Resolution No. 437-25 (File 250851), adopted September 16, 2025. It is a resolution, not an ordinance. In the same questionnaire he says he supports the regional transit ballot measures being developed for November 2026 that SB 63 enables; that is support for a ballot measure, not for SB 63 itself, so it is not recorded here.
